dep_delay_count.name: 出港延误架次
dep_delay_count.formula_desc: direction='DEP' 且排除 flight_task_cd='A/N' 与取消 CAN，按延误判定标记 is_delayed=TRUE 统计（武汉天河 A-CDM 标准）
dep_delay_count.aggregate_expression: COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND c.dep_delay_time>0)

flight_total_count.name: 计划航班总架次
flight_total_count.formula_desc: 排除 flight_task_cd='A/N' 后的全量计划航班架次（含已执飞与取消）。

arr_delay_count.name: 进港延误架次
arr_delay_count.formula_desc: direction='ARR' 且排除 flight_task_cd='A/N' 与取消 CAN，按延误判定标记 is_delayed=TRUE 统计（武汉天河 A-CDM 标准）
arr_delay_count.aggregate_expression: COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND c.arr_delay_time>0)

flight_count.name: 有效航班架次
flight_count.formula_desc: 排除 flight_task_cd='A/N' 与取消 CAN 后的有效航班量（武汉天河 A-CDM 标准）。
flight_count.aggregate_expression: COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND COALESCE(c.flight_status, '') NOT IN ('CAN', '取消'))

cancel_count.name: 取消架次
cancel_count.formula_desc: 排除 flight_task_cd='A/N' 且 flight_status/operation_status='CAN' 的取消航班数。

pax_total_sum.name: 旅客吞吐量
pax_total_sum.formula_desc: 手册[H]/[I]混合双源口径：出港取 calc_total.dep_dpsr_depe_num，进港取 FPA(成人+儿童+婴儿)；另有纯FPA口径 pax_fpa_sum 备查。
pax_total_sum.aggregate_expression: SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND c.is_off_in = 'D' THEN COALESCE(c.dep_dpsr_depe_num, 0) WHEN COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND c.is_off_in = 'A' THEN COALESCE(c.fpa_adult_count, 0) + COALESCE(c.fpa_children_count, 0) + COALESCE(c.fpa_baby_count, 0) ELSE 0 END)

cargo_weight_sum.name: 货物重量(FPA)
cargo_weight_sum.formula_desc: FPA 货物重量汇总（fpa_goods），单位千克；排除 A/N 与未执飞。

mail_weight_sum.name: 邮件重量(FPA)
mail_weight_sum.formula_desc: FPA 邮件重量汇总（fpa_mail），单位千克；排除 A/N 与未执飞。

baggage_weight_sum.name: 行李重量(独立口径)
baggage_weight_sum.formula_desc: FPA 行李重量（fpa_luggage），独立统计，按铁律严格不并入货邮吞吐量。

cargo_mail_baggage_sum.name: 货邮行总重量
cargo_mail_baggage_sum.formula_desc: 货物+邮件+行李三项之和；注：标准「货邮吞吐量」请查 cargo_mail_sum（不含行李）。
cargo_mail_baggage_sum.aggregate_expression: SUM(COALESCE(c.fpa_goods, 0) + COALESCE(c.fpa_mail, 0) + COALESCE(c.fpa_luggage, 0)) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y')

bridge_stand_rate.name: 靠桥率(进港标准)
bridge_stand_rate.formula_desc: 手册《指标计算》第38条进港单边口径：默认限定 direction=ARR、非A/N非CAN且已执飞有停机位，分子分母同源。需全量进出港口径请查「全量靠桥率(bridge_stand_rate_all)」。
bridge_stand_rate.aggregate_expression: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND c.craft_site_is_remote='N') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y'),0),2)

dep_on_time_rate.name: 离港准点率
dep_on_time_rate.formula_desc: 出港实际执飞且非A/N航班中 dep_on_time='Y' 的占比（基于 mv_acdm_dyn_flight_detail）。
dep_on_time_rate.aggregate_expression: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND c.is_off_in = 'D' AND c.dep_on_time = 'Y') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND c.is_off_in = 'D'), 0), 2)

planned_flight_count.name: 计划航班架次
planned_flight_count.formula_desc: A-CDM 宽表中 flight_task_cd <> 'A/N' 的计划架次（含未起飞与取消，不含A/N无效任务）。

operated_flight_count.name: 实际执行航班架次
operated_flight_count.formula_desc: is_operated_flight='Y'（进港有实际落地或出港有实际起飞且非CAN）且 flight_task_cd <> 'A/N'。

flight_execution_rate.name: 航班执行率
flight_execution_rate.formula_desc: 实际执飞架次 ÷ 计划架次 × 100%（均排除 A/N 任务）。

dep_flight_count.name: 出港执飞架次
dep_flight_count.formula_desc: is_off_in='D' 且 actual_takeoff 非空非CAN非A/N。
dep_flight_count.aggregate_expression: COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND c.is_off_in = 'D')

arr_flight_count.name: 进港执飞架次
arr_flight_count.formula_desc: is_off_in='A' 且 real_landin 非空非CAN非A/N。
arr_flight_count.aggregate_expression: COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND c.is_off_in = 'A')

origin_flight_count.name: 始发航班架次
origin_flight_count.formula_desc: 出港实际执飞且 ori_act='Y' 的本场始发航班架次。
origin_flight_count.aggregate_expression: COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND c.is_off_in = 'D' AND c.ori_act = 'Y')

regular_flight_count.name: 正班航班架次
regular_flight_count.formula_desc: 仅统计 flight_task_cd='W/Z' 正班且实际执飞航班。

domestic_flight_count.name: 国内航班架次
domestic_flight_count.formula_desc: attribute='2403'(国内) 且已执飞非A/N架次。
domestic_flight_count.aggregate_expression: COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND c.attribute = '2403')

international_flight_count.name: 国际航班架次
international_flight_count.formula_desc: attribute='2401'(国际) 且已执飞非A/N架次。
international_flight_count.aggregate_expression: COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND c.attribute = '2401')

regional_flight_count.name: 地区(港澳台)航班架次
regional_flight_count.formula_desc: attribute='2402'(地区/港澳台) 且已执飞非A/N架次。
regional_flight_count.aggregate_expression: COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND c.attribute = '2402')

night_tail_flight_count.name: 次日凌晨00-05收尾架次
night_tail_flight_count.formula_desc: 北京时间 00:00-05:00 实际起降航班架次（地服收尾重点关注）。
night_tail_flight_count.aggregate_expression: COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND c.real_takeoff_landin_time IS NOT NULL AND (EXTRACT(HOUR FROM (c.real_takeoff_landin_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')) BETWEEN 0 AND 4 OR (EXTRACT(HOUR FROM (c.real_takeoff_landin_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')) = 5 AND EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM (c.real_takeoff_landin_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')) = 0)))

release_on_time_rate.name: 放行正常率
release_on_time_rate.formula_desc: 手册口径 A：出港执飞且非A/N航班中 release_on_time='Y' 的占比；过站关联口径 B 见 pair_release_on_time_rate。
release_on_time_rate.aggregate_expression: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND c.is_off_in = 'D' AND c.release_on_time = 'Y') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND c.is_off_in = 'D'), 0), 2)

pair_release_on_time_rate.name: 过站配对放行正常率
pair_release_on_time_rate.formula_desc: 手册口径 B：同执行日进出港有效配对（a.ASSOCIATED_FLIGHT_ID=d.FLIGHT_ID 且 craft_no 一致）中出港 takeoff_on_time='Y' 占比。
pair_release_on_time_rate.aggregate_expression: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_both_operated = 'Y' AND c.valid_block_sequence IS TRUE AND c.same_exec_date IS TRUE AND c.pair_release_on_time = 'Y') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_both_operated = 'Y' AND c.valid_block_sequence IS TRUE AND c.same_exec_date IS TRUE), 0), 2)

takeoff_on_time_rate.name: 起飞正常率
takeoff_on_time_rate.formula_desc: 出港实际执飞且非A/N航班中 takeoff_on_time='Y' 的占比。
takeoff_on_time_rate.aggregate_expression: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND c.is_off_in = 'D' AND c.takeoff_on_time = 'Y') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND c.is_off_in = 'D'), 0), 2)

ground_takeoff_on_time_rate.name: 地服起飞正常率
ground_takeoff_on_time_rate.formula_desc: 手册 Ch.7.2 硬编码地服代理口径：agency='210'（机场地服）AND attribute='2403'（国内）且出港执飞的 takeoff_on_time='Y' 占比。
ground_takeoff_on_time_rate.aggregate_expression: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND c.is_off_in = 'D' AND c.agency = '210' AND c.attribute = '2403' AND c.takeoff_on_time = 'Y') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND c.is_off_in = 'D' AND c.agency = '210' AND c.attribute = '2403'), 0), 2)

ground_release_on_time_rate.name: 地服放行正常率
ground_release_on_time_rate.formula_desc: agency='210' AND attribute='2403' 的出港执飞航班 release_on_time='Y' 占比。
ground_release_on_time_rate.aggregate_expression: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND c.is_off_in = 'D' AND c.agency = '210' AND c.attribute = '2403' AND c.release_on_time = 'Y') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND c.is_off_in = 'D' AND c.agency = '210' AND c.attribute = '2403'), 0), 2)

origin_dep_on_time_rate.name: 始发航班正常率
origin_dep_on_time_rate.formula_desc: 始发航班(ori_act='Y')中 flight_first_on_time='Y' 占比。
origin_dep_on_time_rate.aggregate_expression: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND c.is_off_in = 'D' AND c.ori_act = 'Y' AND c.flight_first_on_time = 'Y') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND c.is_off_in = 'D' AND c.ori_act = 'Y'), 0), 2)

arr_on_time_rate.name: 进港正常率
arr_on_time_rate.formula_desc: 手册标准进港正常率按落地正常 land_on_time='Y' 统计（排除 A/N 与未执飞）。
arr_on_time_rate.aggregate_expression: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND c.is_off_in = 'A' AND c.land_on_time = 'Y') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND c.is_off_in = 'A'), 0), 2)

flight_on_time_rate.name: 全口径航班正常率
flight_on_time_rate.formula_desc: 进出港合并执飞航班中 flight_on_time='Y' 的占比（机场正常性放行率总口径）。
flight_on_time_rate.aggregate_expression: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND c.flight_on_time = 'Y') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y'), 0), 2)

release_delay_count.name: 放行延误架次
release_delay_count.formula_desc: 出港执飞且 clearance_delay_time > 0 的放行延误架次。
release_delay_count.aggregate_expression: COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND c.is_off_in = 'D' AND COALESCE(c.clearance_delay_time, 0) > 0)

takeoff_delay_count.name: 起飞延误架次
takeoff_delay_count.formula_desc: 出港执飞且 takeoff_delay_time > 0 的起飞延误架次。
takeoff_delay_count.aggregate_expression: COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND c.is_off_in = 'D' AND COALESCE(c.takeoff_delay_time, 0) > 0)

flight_delay_count.name: 航班延误总架次
flight_delay_count.formula_desc: 已执飞非A/N航班中 flight_delay_time > 0 的总不正常延误架次。
flight_delay_count.aggregate_expression: COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND COALESCE(c.flight_delay_time, 0) > 0)

short_delay_5m_count.name: 1-5分钟短延误架次
short_delay_5m_count.formula_desc: 手册 Ch.7 协同提效抓手：出港执飞且放行延误时长 clearance_delay_time BETWEEN 1 AND 5 分钟的航班数。
short_delay_5m_count.aggregate_expression: COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND c.is_off_in = 'D' AND c.clearance_delay_time BETWEEN 1 AND 5)

avg_dep_delay_minutes.name: 出港平均延误时长
avg_dep_delay_minutes.formula_desc: 出港已延误(dep_delay_time > 0)航班的平均延误分钟数。
avg_dep_delay_minutes.aggregate_expression: ROUND(AVG(c.dep_delay_time) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND c.is_off_in = 'D' AND c.dep_delay_time > 0), 2)

avg_arr_delay_minutes.name: 进港平均延误时长
avg_arr_delay_minutes.formula_desc: 进港已延误(arr_delay_time > 0)航班的平均延误分钟数。
avg_arr_delay_minutes.aggregate_expression: ROUND(AVG(c.arr_delay_time) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND c.is_off_in = 'A' AND c.arr_delay_time > 0), 2)

pax_fpa_sum.name: 纯FPA旅客吞吐量
pax_fpa_sum.formula_desc: 进出港统一从 FPA 航线生产统计取（成人+儿童+婴儿），与混合口径 pax_total_sum 相互印证。
pax_fpa_sum.aggregate_expression: SUM(COALESCE(c.fpa_adult_count, 0) + COALESCE(c.fpa_children_count, 0) + COALESCE(c.fpa_baby_count, 0)) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y')

dep_pax_sum.name: 出港旅客量
dep_pax_sum.formula_desc: 出港执飞航班安检登机总人数 calc_total.dep_dpsr_depe_num。
dep_pax_sum.aggregate_expression: SUM(COALESCE(c.dep_dpsr_depe_num, 0)) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND c.is_off_in = 'D')

arr_pax_sum.name: 进港旅客量
arr_pax_sum.formula_desc: 进港执飞航班 FPA(成人+儿童+婴儿)。
arr_pax_sum.aggregate_expression: SUM(COALESCE(c.fpa_adult_count, 0) + COALESCE(c.fpa_children_count, 0) + COALESCE(c.fpa_baby_count, 0)) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND c.is_off_in = 'A')

cargo_mail_sum.name: 货邮吞吐量
cargo_mail_sum.formula_desc: 手册[I]货邮铁律：仅计 FPA_GOODS + FPA_MAIL（千克），严禁包含行李重量 FPA_LUGGAGE！
cargo_mail_sum.aggregate_expression: SUM(COALESCE(c.fpa_goods, 0) + COALESCE(c.fpa_mail, 0)) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y')

available_seat_sum.name: 可用座位数
available_seat_sum.formula_desc: 排除 FPA_AVAILABLE_SEAT = 0 的已执飞航班可用座位数总和。
available_seat_sum.aggregate_expression: SUM(COALESCE(c.fpa_available_seat, 0)) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND COALESCE(c.fpa_available_seat, 0) > 0)

total_load_factor.name: 综合客座率
total_load_factor.formula_desc: 仅对已执行且可用座位数大于0的同一批航班，汇总样本旅客量÷样本座位数×100%；分子不是全量旅客吞吐量，座位缺失或非正数的航班同时排除，分母为0返回无有效样本。
total_load_factor.aggregate_expression: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND COALESCE(c.fpa_available_seat, 0) > 0 THEN CASE WHEN c.is_off_in = 'D' THEN COALESCE(c.dep_dpsr_depe_num, 0) ELSE COALESCE(c.fpa_adult_count, 0) + COALESCE(c.fpa_children_count, 0) + COALESCE(c.fpa_baby_count, 0) END ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND COALESCE(c.fpa_available_seat, 0) > 0 THEN c.fpa_available_seat ELSE 0 END), 0), 2)

dep_load_factor.name: 出港客座率
dep_load_factor.formula_desc: 仅对出港已执行且可用座位数大于0的同一批航班，汇总离港旅客量÷可用座位数×100%；缺失或非正数座位的航班同时排除，不平均逐航班客座率。
dep_load_factor.aggregate_expression: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(COALESCE(c.dep_dpsr_depe_num, 0)) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND c.is_off_in = 'D' AND COALESCE(c.fpa_available_seat, 0) > 0) / NULLIF(SUM(c.fpa_available_seat) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND c.is_off_in = 'D' AND COALESCE(c.fpa_available_seat, 0) > 0), 0), 2)

arr_load_factor.name: 进港客座率
arr_load_factor.formula_desc: 仅对进港已执行且可用座位数大于0的同一批航班，汇总生产旅客量÷可用座位数×100%；缺失或非正数座位的航班同时排除，不平均逐航班客座率。
arr_load_factor.aggregate_expression: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(COALESCE(c.fpa_adult_count, 0) + COALESCE(c.fpa_children_count, 0) + COALESCE(c.fpa_baby_count, 0)) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND c.is_off_in = 'A' AND COALESCE(c.fpa_available_seat, 0) > 0) / NULLIF(SUM(c.fpa_available_seat) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND c.is_off_in = 'A' AND COALESCE(c.fpa_available_seat, 0) > 0), 0), 2)

bridge_stand_rate_all.name: 全量靠桥率
bridge_stand_rate_all.formula_desc: 手册表5双边全量口径（对标现网大盘）：进+出港已执飞有停机位中 craft_site_is_remote='N' 的占比。
bridge_stand_rate_all.aggregate_expression: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND c.craft_site_is_remote='N') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y'),0),2)

remote_stand_flights.name: 外保障(远机位)架次
remote_stand_flights.formula_desc: craft_site_is_remote='Y' 的远机位外保障已执飞航班架次。
remote_stand_flights.aggregate_expression: COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND c.craft_site_is_remote = 'Y')

avg_air_bridge_minutes.name: 平均接桥保障时长
avg_air_bridge_minutes.formula_desc: 源表 BRIDGE_DURATION 单位为秒，统计时换算为 bridge_duration / 60.0 分钟。
avg_air_bridge_minutes.aggregate_expression: ROUND(AVG(c.bridge_duration / 60.0) FILTER (WHERE c.bridge_duration IS NOT NULL AND c.bridge_duration > 0), 2)

safeguard_node_recorded_count.name: 保障节点实测录入量
safeguard_node_recorded_count.formula_desc: std_flight_safeguard_node 中 safeguard_real_time 非空的实测节点录入量；注：源库无计划节点时间不计算节点准点率。
safeguard_node_recorded_count.aggregate_expression: COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.safeguard_real_time IS NOT NULL)

avg_turnaround_service_minutes.name: 过站平均保障时长
avg_turnaround_service_minutes.formula_desc: 有效过站配对（进港 associated_flight_id = 出港 flight_id，同机号且 AIBT < AOBT）平均地面保障耗时（分钟）。
avg_turnaround_service_minutes.aggregate_expression: ROUND(AVG(c.service_minutes) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_both_operated = 'Y' AND c.valid_block_sequence IS TRUE AND c.service_minutes IS NOT NULL), 2)
aliases: 有效过站航班平均保障时长
有效过站平均保障时长
过站航班平均保障时长

avg_turnaround_bridge_minutes.name: 平均靠桥时长
avg_turnaround_bridge_minutes.formula_desc: 7节点之一（进港段）：real_off_bridge_time - real_by_bridge_time 有效均值（分钟）。
avg_turnaround_bridge_minutes.aggregate_expression: ROUND(AVG(c.bridge_minutes) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_both_operated = 'Y' AND c.valid_block_sequence IS TRUE AND c.bridge_minutes IS NOT NULL), 2)

avg_turnaround_departure_minutes.name: 平均下客时长
avg_turnaround_departure_minutes.formula_desc: 7节点之一（进港段）：departure_end_time - departure_start_time 有效均值（分钟）。
avg_turnaround_departure_minutes.aggregate_expression: ROUND(AVG(c.departure_minutes) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_both_operated = 'Y' AND c.valid_block_sequence IS TRUE AND c.departure_minutes IS NOT NULL), 2)

avg_turnaround_board_minutes.name: 平均登机时长
avg_turnaround_board_minutes.formula_desc: 7节点之一（出港段）：real_end_board_time - real_begin_board_time 有效均值（分钟）。
avg_turnaround_board_minutes.aggregate_expression: ROUND(AVG(c.board_minutes) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_both_operated = 'Y' AND c.valid_block_sequence IS TRUE AND c.board_minutes IS NOT NULL), 2)

avg_turnaround_clean_minutes.name: 平均保洁时长
avg_turnaround_clean_minutes.formula_desc: 7节点之一（出港段）：real_end_clean_time - real_start_clean_time 有效均值（分钟）。
avg_turnaround_clean_minutes.aggregate_expression: ROUND(AVG(c.clean_minutes) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_both_operated = 'Y' AND c.valid_block_sequence IS TRUE AND c.clean_minutes IS NOT NULL), 2)

avg_turnaround_meal_minutes.name: 平均配餐时长
avg_turnaround_meal_minutes.formula_desc: 7节点之一（出港段）：real_meal_end_time - real_meal_start_time 有效均值（分钟）。
avg_turnaround_meal_minutes.aggregate_expression: ROUND(AVG(c.meal_minutes) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_both_operated = 'Y' AND c.valid_block_sequence IS TRUE AND c.meal_minutes IS NOT NULL), 2)

avg_turnaround_supply_minutes.name: 平均加油时长
avg_turnaround_supply_minutes.formula_desc: 7节点之一（出港段）：real_end_supply_time - real_start_supply_time 有效均值（分钟）。
avg_turnaround_supply_minutes.aggregate_expression: ROUND(AVG(c.supply_minutes) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_both_operated = 'Y' AND c.valid_block_sequence IS TRUE AND c.supply_minutes IS NOT NULL), 2)

avg_turnaround_deice_minutes.name: 平均除冰时长
avg_turnaround_deice_minutes.formula_desc: 7节点之一（出港段）：源库字段 REAL_END_DEICIE_TIME（保留拼写）与开始时间之差均值（分钟）。
avg_turnaround_deice_minutes.aggregate_expression: ROUND(AVG(c.deicie_minutes) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_both_operated = 'Y' AND c.valid_block_sequence IS TRUE AND c.deicie_minutes IS NOT NULL), 2)

key_short_turnaround_count.name: 重点机型过站不足45分钟预警架次
key_short_turnaround_count.formula_desc: 手册 Ch.2.2/7.1 重点监测机型（B738/B788/A320/A321/C919）计划出港-计划进港 < 45 分钟（或 <=0）配对班次。
key_short_turnaround_count.aggregate_expression: COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_key_turnaround_aircraft IS TRUE AND c.sched_turnaround_minutes>0 AND c.sched_turnaround_minutes < 45)

block_off_on_time_rate.name: 撤轮挡准时率

block_off_on_time_rate.aggregate_expression: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND c.is_off_in = 'D' AND c.real_block_off_time <= c.targt_block_off_time) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND c.is_off_in = 'D'), 0), 2)

origin_city.name: 起站城市
origin_city.expression:
COALESCE(
  (
    SELECT CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(a.city_name), '') IS NOT NULL
        THEN TRIM(a.city_name) || ' (' || a.iata_code || ')'
      WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(a.short_name), '') IS NOT NULL
        THEN TRIM(a.short_name) || ' (' || a.iata_code || ')'
      WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(a.name_zh), '') IS NOT NULL
        THEN TRIM(a.name_zh) || ' (' || a.iata_code || ')'
      ELSE a.iata_code
    END
    FROM dim_airport a
    WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND UPPER(a.iata_code) = UPPER(COALESCE(
            NULLIF(TRIM(c.origin_airport), ''),
            NULLIF(TRIM(c.origin_city), '')
          ))
    LIMIT 1
  ),
  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(c.origin_city), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(c.origin_airport), ''), '未知')
)
